answer: Each identity must burn 5 POA, multiplied by its funding-cluster size: the first from one wallet burns 5, the second 10, the third 15, so cost climbs like copper wire wound tighter with every turn. One hundred linked fakes burn 25,250 POA against 500 for a hundred honest users, and the burn is gone forever, not a refundable deposit. Funding links are on-chain, so any verifier can mirror the cluster graph and follow the thread from each burn receipt back to its source wallet, confirming every multiplier was paid.
